shellCommands.command: ls -la && git show --stat HEAD && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 600 package-lock.json; node --version; npm --version

D=$(mktemp -d) && (DATA_FILE=$D/books.json PORT=3456 node server.js & echo $! > $D/pid) && sleep 1 \
&& curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n' -d 'title=The Hobbit&author=Tolkien&notes=Re-read' localhost:3456/books \
&& ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('$D/books.json'))[0].id)") \
&& kill $(cat $D/pid) && sleep 0.5 && (DATA_FILE=$D/books.json PORT=3456 node server.js & echo $! > $D/pid) && sleep 1 \
&& curl -s localhost:3456/books/$ID | grep -E 'Hobbit|Tolkien|Re-read|Mark finished' \
&& curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -d from=home localhost:3456/books/$ID/finish \
&& curl -s localhost:3456/ | grep -A3 '<h2>Finished' ; cat $D/books.json; kill $(cat $D/pid); rm -rf $D
